title: vitis helleri
intro: Vitis helleri, commonly known as the Heller's grapevine, is a type of woody vine native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia and China. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that can help alleviate symptoms of various ailments, such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Vitis helleri include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which can help reduce inflammation, lower fever, and facilitate the expulsion of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
